name: UF-ega-item-icon-32
note: 32x32 inventory icon on the EGA palette, transparent. Pixel Art XL draws tiny icons best; outlines/angles off. — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 1. Twin of FACTORY/ega-item-icon-32.  (sample: seed 1349)

form.subject: a (shiny red apple:1.3) with a (green leaf:1.1)
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (multiple, sprite sheet, collage:1.3), cropped, (person, hand:1.3)

sample_command: pixelmon 'a (shiny red apple:1.3) with a (green leaf:1.1)' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora pixel-art-xl.safetensors --lora-strength 1 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (multiple, sprite sheet, collage:1.3), cropped, (person, hand:1.3)' --style item --out 32x32 --palette EGA --despeckle 1 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --transparent --pixel-size 1x1 --seed 1349
